references.text: Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, is mentioned again as the leader of the tribe of Simeon during the camp arrangements.
Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, brings his offering as the prince of the tribe of Simeon at the dedication of the altar.
Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, leads the army of the tribe of Simeon during the wilderness journey.
Simeon was born as Leah's second son, and the tribe of Simeon descends from him.
The sons of Simeon are mentioned when Jacob went down to Egypt, showing the origin of the tribe.
